recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce the original R5-era qualifiedInterval, bodySite, subjectCodeableConcept, or customaryUnit wording; those names are stale for the current resource model.
issue_request: FHIR-28613 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested replacing ObservationDefinition section 8.26.2, "Boundaries and Relationships", with narrative explaining that an Observation may instantiate an ObservationDefinition and should inherit corresponding definitional characteristics, including category/code/value type, reference ranges, valid coded values, subject, device, specimen, and unit handling.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Jira records the requested text and an "Added to the build" PR commit, while local history shows FHIR-28613 commits 48d31af3b7/2757b927a8 adding the replacement narrative, 6e8533f366 updating qualifiedValues wording to qualifiedValue, and 51a7c5808c aligning the section more closely to the final Jira proposal.
additional_context: ObservationDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/observationdefinition/observationdefinition-introduction.xml is in current build scope. Later source and Jira changes changed the resource model and the matching narrative: the current resource uses bodyStructure instead of bodySite, qualifiedValue instead of qualifiedInterval, subject instead of subjectCodeableConcept, and permittedUnit instead of the older unit/customaryUnit text. FHIR-40678 specifically replaced the old customaryUnit paragraph with permittedUnit wording, so the current wording is an intentional later correction rather than missed FHIR-28613 text.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because the active Boundaries and Relationships section already conveys the approved FHIR-28613 relationship and inheritance guidance using current ObservationDefinition element names.
